title: When the Contact Turns Anew
author: Jude Okafor
blurb: Ulyana Underhill, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
